# uptimekuma_notification_gorush (Resource)

Gorush notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic Gorush notification with required fields
resource "uptimekuma_notification_gorush" "basic" {
  name         = "Basic Gorush Notification"
  server_url   = "https://gorush.example.com"
  device_token = "your-device-token-here"
  platform     = "ios"
  is_default   = false
}

# Gorush notification with all optional fields
resource "uptimekuma_notification_gorush" "full" {
  name         = "Full Gorush Notification"
  server_url   = "https://gorush.example.com"
  device_token = "your-device-token-here"
  platform     = "android"
  title        = "Uptime Kuma Alert"
  priority     = "high"
  retry        = 3
  topic        = "uptime-alerts"
  is_default   = false
}

# Gorush notification for web push
resource "uptimekuma_notification_gorush" "web" {
  name         = "Web Push Notification"
  server_url   = "https://gorush.example.com"
  device_token = "web-device-subscription-key"
  platform     = "web"
  title        = "Status Update"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_token` (String, Sensitive) Device token for the push notification
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `platform` (String) Platform (ios, android, huawei, web)
- `server_url` (String, Sensitive) Gorush server URL

### Optional

- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Attach this notification to all existing monitors. This is a one-time action: it runs when the notification is created with `true`, or when the value changes from `false` to `true`. Other updates do not attach it again, so monitors detached from the notification later stay detached. Uptime Kuma does not store the value, so the provider keeps it from the configuration. An imported notification starts with `false`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `priority` (String) Notification priority
- `retry` (Number) Number of retries
- `title` (String) Notification title
- `topic` (String) Notification topic

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
